White Space

Normal (default) - wraps and collapses whitespace

This text has multiple spaces and a line break.

Nowrap - no wrapping, collapses whitespace

This text has multiple spaces and a very long line that should not wrap.

Pre - preserves whitespace and no wrapping

This text has multiple spaces and a line break. Indented line.

Pre-wrap - preserves whitespace and wraps

This text has multiple spaces and a line break. Indented line that is very long and should wrap to the next line.

Pre-line - preserves line breaks, collapses spaces, wraps

This text has multiple spaces and a line break. Indented line that is very long and should wrap to the next line.
